Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create `Expansion Assist cohort comparison — Q1 vs Jul–Sep 2026` as two like-structured historical entries. Include each period, denominator, complete-window status, request and expansion counts and rates, and Customer Success exclusion. Keep cohorts separate, state whether the evidence included a randomized comparison, and explain what that means for interpreting the observed rates.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Expansion Assist cohort comparison — Q1 vs Jul–Sep 2026", "body": "Recorded: 2028-01-01

Historical entry 1 — Q1 2026 cohort

Period
December 1, 2025–January 30, 2026.

Denominator
18 actual Expansion Assist exposures.

Complete-window status
All 18 exposure records had complete, closed 45-day outcome windows. January exposures were included only after their windows matured; incomplete windows were not counted.

Observed outcomes
- Help-or-options requests: 6 of 18, or 33.3%.
- Expansions: 4 of 18, or 22.2%.

Customer Success exclusion
Every included exposure met the standing current-state eligibility criteria, and no exposed account had active Customer Success adoption or renewal work at the time of exposure.

Evidence design and interpretation
The evidence did not include a randomized comparison or randomized control. These are observed exposed-cohort rates, not treatment-versus-control lift estimates. They can describe what happened after exposure in this cohort, but they cannot establish that Expansion Assist caused the requests or expansions, quantify incremental lift, or support pipeline, revenue, or forecast credit. Differences from another period may reflect account mix, timing, seasonality, eligibility, or operating conditions rather than an effect of the assist.

Historical entry 2 — Jul–Sep 2026 cohort

Period
July 1–September 15, 2026, representing the certified complete-window evidence within the Jul–Sep 2026 period.

Denominator
16 actual Expansion Assist exposures.

Complete-window status
All 16 exposure records had complete, closed 45-day outcome windows.

Observed outcomes
- Help-or-options requests: 6 of 16, or 37.5%.
- Expansions: 4 of 16, or 25.0%.

Customer Success exclusion
No exposed account had active Customer Success adoption or renewal work at the time of exposure; the standing eligibility criteria applied to every exposure.

Evidence design and interpretation
The evidence did not include a randomized comparison or randomized control. These are observed exposed-cohort rates, not treatment-versus-control lift estimates. They can describe what happened after exposure in this cohort, but they cannot establish that Expansion Assist caused the requests or expansions, quantify incremental lift, or support pipeline, revenue, or forecast credit. The higher observed rates than in the Q1 2026 entry should not be read as causal improvement: the cohorts may differ in account mix, timing, seasonality, eligibility, or operating conditions.

Cross-entry note
Keep the cohorts separate. The figures are descriptive cohort summaries with different denominators and periods, not a pooled estimate and not a randomized comparison. Across both entries, the Customer Success adoption/renewal-work exclusion is part of cohort eligibility and should not be interpreted as evidence that the exclusion itself caused the observed outcomes."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_173_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document contains a distinct entry for the locked Q1 cohort that accurately states: exposure period December 1 through January 30; fixed denominator of 18 actual exposures; all exposures have complete 45-day outcome windows; 6 help-or-options requests, calculated as 33.3% of 18; 4 expansions, calculated as 22.2% of 18; and no account had active Customer Success adoption or renewal work at exposure. Missing, materially ambiguous, or contradictory values must fail.

The document keeps the two cohorts and their denominators separate rather than pooling them, and gives a shared interpretation that treats the observed request and expansion rates as descriptive only. Historical entry 2 — Jul–Sep 2026 cohort

Period

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_173_02","passed":true,"reason":"The document provides separate Q1 and Jul–Sep 2026 entries.
